svg.text: Isolated test — the node alone, both neighbours mocked
Four container nodes on one bridge. Two images reach this Room; the bench image serves both mock roles, the role picked by env.
emits one object message per tick
one L2 segment · 10.99.0.0/24 · one ethernet pin per node
ADA View Log — the [EVT] stream: ingest, track_transition, assessment, r4_tx
Inside the ADA container — capture.sh writes [CAP] lines and a rotating pcap of the ADA-to-IVI hop
ivi_mock View Log — [RX], [CHECK] and [SUMMARY], one pair of lines per warning datagram
v2x_mock View Log — [TX], the send count the ingest rate is measured against
Host side, after the run: tools/check_zero_c.py and tools/check_run_alignment.py read the saved [EVT] stream — no live access to the node is needed.
Both images build on GitHub Actions with docker buildx for linux/arm64, are pushed to registry.hackathon-2.carsky.io, and each node pulls its own by tag.
